name: @w6w-apps/lokalise
description: Manage Lokalise projects, keys, translations, languages, files, contributors, tasks and webhooks.

w6w.longDescription:
Lokalise is a translation and localization management platform: strings live as keys with per-language translations, organized into projects, exported as files in the format each platform (iOS, Android, web, ...) expects.

This app covers the path a workflow actually needs around that: manage projects and their languages, create and update keys and translations, upload a source file for Lokalise to parse and queue for translation, and export a project's current translations as a downloadable bundle. Beyond the core content, it covers contributors (who can translate what), comments (in-context notes on a key), tasks (assigning translation work with a due date) and webhooks (reacting to a translation event instead of polling for it).

A structural fact shapes every 'create' action here: Lokalise's create endpoints are bulk-only — even creating one key, language, contributor or comment means POSTing an array of one, and a 200 response can still carry a per-item 'errors' array for partial failure. Every bulk action in this app surfaces that array rather than assuming HTTP success means every item succeeded.
